studied: 2026-09-29 (from the agent's recordings of two Steelcase runs)
steps: Select your resume -> Personal info (one long page: contact, work experience, education, languages, attachments) -> Questionnaire

fields.resume_step: 'Choose an option to apply': buttons Copy & Paste / Without Resume / From Device; 'From Device' reveals 'From Device *  No file selected  [Choose another file]' -- the box never says 'resume'
fields.resume_reader: the site parses the uploaded resume and pre-fills Work Experience and Education -- often wrongly (dates paired with the wrong jobs, wrong 'Is current position?'); these are the site's values, to be checked
fields.text: textbox named by a separate generic label ('First Name *'); a value typed into a box with a placeholder shows as a child 'text:' line
fields.single_choice: native-looking combobox with options 'Select an option', ...

search_and_pick.widget: combobox 'Institution' holding a child textbox named by the picked value plus a × button
search_and_pick.value_shown: the child textbox's name IS the chosen value ('Eastern Illinois University')

fields.repeated_entries: Work Experience (Company, Position title, Is current position?, Start date, End date, Remove / Add Another) and Education History (Type of Degree, Area of Study, Country of Institution, Institution, Status) repeat the same bare labels per entry -- see repeated_entries.py
fields.dates: native date inputs (value yyyy-mm-dd, shown mm/dd/yyyy)
fields.multi_select: Areas of Interest: a list box allowing several
fields.languages: Language / Written Level / Spoken Level with 'Native', 'Advanced', 'Intermediate', 'Beginner' ('Fluent' must map to one of these)
fields.attachments: a second Resume and Cover Letter file input at the bottom of Personal info, separate from the first step's upload
